card.title: Say You Saw It Too
card.instruction: Get someone to admit noticing the impossible detail before you reveal how much you believe it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Did you notice the shadow reaching the door first?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd rather hear your order of events.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yes, it moved before the chair.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Now I can admit I held the door for it.

mechanism: A obtains corroboration of an impossible observation before admitting having already acted on belief in it.
confusable: Unlike simply asking a witness what happened, A explicitly delays revealing A's deeper commitment until B confirms.
comparison: A shadow's early movement licenses the admission of holding a door; the soup scene licenses feeding an animated noodle.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
